title: About: Goal (The goal of Learn Try Earn)

f1.default: The goal of Learn Try Earn

f2.default: A practical understanding of financial markets, with gold and silver at the centre and Bitcoin and Ethereum alongside. Built on a process you understand.

f3.default: Whether you are starting from scratch or looking to bring more structure to your approach, the aim is to help you develop stronger foundations.

default.k2: Know what moves gold, silver and crypto, and when each is most active.
Decide what you’re looking for before the session starts.
Define the downside first and size every position from it.
Look back at every decision, including the ones that didn’t work.
